_README: ONE config file drives the whole tracker (scraper + dashboard). Edit it by hand, or generate it from your CV using docs/cv-to-config-prompt.md. After editing, commit it and re-run the workflows. All matching is case-insensitive substring on the JOB TITLE unless noted.

profile.title: ML / AI / Data Science Job Tracker
profile.subtitle: SF Bay Area · Remote (US)

keywords._comment: A job TITLE is kept if it contains any of these. Use full words; multi-word phrases match as substrings.
keywords._exclude_comment: Titles containing any of these are dropped. Covers junior/intern, analyst roles, ETL & data-engineering, QA, sales, frontend, recruiting, people-management (IC-only), non-tech wet-lab science, and non-AI enterprise/architect flavors.
keywords._fuzzy_comment: Optional fuzzy pre-filter for LinkedIn title matching. When both fuzzy_seniority and fuzzy_domain are non-empty, role_is_relevant() uses these instead of the exact-phrase keywords.include filter. Leave all three empty to use keyword-only matching.

search_terms._comment: Queries sent to the job boards' search boxes. Broader than 'keywords' (which then filters the titles).

locations._comment: LinkedIn needs a geoId (find via the guest endpoint; leave blank to let LinkedIn resolve the text). JobSpy-backed boards such as Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, and Google Jobs need a location + country (USA, Australia, Canada, GB...). HiringCafe currently uses its public US SEO route; locations.hiring_cafe is kept for compatibility. The map auto-fits to wherever the jobs are.
locations._linkedin_partitions_comment: Optional. Used by --linkedin-emit-matrix / --linkedin-backfill-partition for parallel backfill. Each state gets one matrix worker per search term. High-volume states can be day-sliced to work around LinkedIn's ~1000 result/query cap. Leave empty to use single-run backfill (--linkedin-backfill).

location_filter._comment: Case-insensitive substrings matched against a job's location text. Used to post-filter boards that don't support geo-scoping at the API level: the curated direct-ATS sweep, and NEOGOV/GovernmentJobs.com (a nationwide board). Keep this in sync with your locations.* entries above. NOTE: intentionally Bay-Area + remote only; add "california" here if you want California-wide results.

google_jobs._comment: Optional exact Google Jobs queries. Leave empty to auto-build queries such as '<term> jobs near <location> since yesterday' from search_terms.google_jobs and locations.google_jobs. If the free JobSpy path is blocked, set SERPAPI_API_KEY or OXYLABS_USERNAME/OXYLABS_PASSWORD as GitHub Actions secrets for an API fallback.

jobspy._comment: Optional. Prefer JOBSPY_PROXIES as a GitHub Actions secret/env var for private proxy credentials. Use only if JobSpy-backed boards are blocked.

hiring_cafe._comment: Uses HiringCafe's public SSR /jobs/<query> pages. max_pages caps SEO pagination per query; the public route currently defaults to United States.

csucareers._comment: Pagination depth for the CSU Careers board (read by scrape_jobs.py as csucareers.max_pages).

employers._priority_comment: Optional. Companies worth a daily 'priority' digest even on a quiet day (case-insensitive substring match on the company name). Kept to ~20 because the digest runs ONE LinkedIn search PER ENTRY - a long list makes the run impractically slow. Trim or extend freely.
employers._exclude_comment: Optional. Drop roles from these companies even if the title matches (case-insensitive substring). Used here to remove staffing/recruiting agencies that repost the same roles.

priority_topics._comment: Optional. Roles touching these get a gold ★ + a 'Priority topics' filter on the dashboard. [name, regex] pairs.
terms: \bllm\b|large language model|genai|gen ai|generative ai|foundation model|frontier model

role_categories._comment: Dashboard 'Role' filter buckets, applied top-to-bottom to each title (first match wins). [name, regex] pairs.
terms: \bllm\b|large language model|genai|gen ai|generative ai|foundation model|frontier model
solutions? architect|ai architect|ml architect|machine learning architect|genai architect
ai engineer|machine learning engineer|\bml engineer\b|artificial intelligence engineer|deep learning|natural language|\bnlp\b|computer vision|machine learning|recommendation|reinforcement learning

notify._comment: Pushover phone alerts (optional; needs PUSHOVER_TOKEN/USER secrets). NOTE: notify.py reads the threshold from the NOTIFY_MIN_FIT repository variable, not from min_fit below; the weekly digest is gated by the WEEKLY_DIGEST_PUSHOVER variable. Only weekly_digest.days is read from this file.

weekly_digest._comment: Optional weekly Pushover brief. Prefer enabling via the WEEKLY_DIGEST_PUSHOVER repository variable so forks stay quiet by default.
